title: Versus network
description: versus/network.yaml of the game pack: the servers the online versus uses to pair two machines and open a route between them (packages/game/versus/network.hpp, docs/modulos/game/versus.md).

signal_server.description: The signaling server (services/versus-signal), ws:// or wss://. Empty: none is set up.

ice_servers.description: STUN or TURN servers, as stun:, turn: or turns: URLs.
